claims.original_statement: AirProof combines robust digital twins, fairness, DTN, privacy and blockchain-supported accountability in one citizen-sensing architecture.
claims.v4_mechanism_evidence: Historical v4 primary establishes H1-H7 for its original execution; transfer, DTN, privacy and accountability remain separately scoped components.
claims.v6_current_mechanism: A common trace/resource/clock interface and four internal-reference adapters exist; no complete five-factor scientific campaign has run.
claims.assumptions: Changed mechanisms cannot inherit old outcomes; component effects do not compose without a matched execution.
claims.reuse_status: Retain v4 efficacy only in its original execution; v6 adapters are engineering evidence.
claims.changed_part: v6 makes common traces/resources/clocks, evidence roles and failure states explicit.
claims.acceptance_criteria: Complete matched five-factor factorial; all original targets; faithful external baselines; independent locked confirmation.
claims.unverified_scope: Scientific whole-system comparison, full factorial, primary and confirmation.
claims.status: incomplete; original integrated claim target retained

claims.original_statement: Original contribution2: uncertainty-aware graph state-space twin with clipped quality weighting, Huber robustness and explicit privacy-noise variance.
claims.v4_mechanism_evidence: Historical v4 H1-H5 passed Holm and Beijing transfer passed its registered 5% noninferiority test.
claims.assumptions: Citizen-independent causal public predictor; absolute cap 8; lag 6; same arrivals/support/clock; fixed public context/operators and preceding boundary for fixed-window sensitivity.
claims.acceptance_criteria: Clean Huber/SQ <=1.05; drift and hotspot attenuation >=20%; event-recall loss <=5pp; all numerical/resource invariants.
claims.unverified_scope: A changed-v6 estimator with an independently supported drift bound, external validation for that mechanism, integrated primary and confirmation.
claims.reuse_status: Retain v4 H1-H5/Beijing historically; do not relabel them for changed v6.
claims.changed_part: Residual-coordinate Huber, world-cross-fitted citizen-public covariance, exact causal residual forcing, causal lifetime exposure accounting, recursive replacement-stability certificate and matched public-only controls.
claims.status: development nomination obtained; independent changed-v6 validation adverse at the drift gate; target unchanged
claims.v6_current_mechanism: Sequential exposed development corrected provenance, covariance, residual forcing and rolling-window lifetime accounting, then nominated lifetime budget 28. The locked independent 12-world, five-cell, four-method validation completed 240/240 rows with all invariants and seven of eight gates passing. It remained an overall FAIL because the preregistered severe-drift attenuation lower bound was undefined after one nonpositive SQ-excess bootstrap draw; finite-only and direct 20% post-hoc contrasts also failed. This result does not replace historical v4 efficacy or authorize primary, EPA test or confirmation.

claims.original_statement: Original contribution3: deficit-aware online scheduling and relay priority enforce minimum neighborhood coverage.
claims.v4_mechanism_evidence: Historical v4 H6 contributor-gap and H7 worst-group-RMSE targets passed in its original execution.
claims.assumptions: Disjoint representatives; additive nonnegative integer costs; per-epoch causal reduction; no raw-pool or starvation theorem.
claims.acceptance_criteria: H6 contributor-gap reduction >=20%; H7 worst-group RMSE reduction >=10%; zero floor/byte/resource violations.
claims.unverified_scope: Raw-pool optimality, starvation freedom, opportunity procurement, clean primary and real-world justice.
claims.reuse_status: Retain favorable v4 H6-H7 historically; changed-v6 adverse validation remains separate.
claims.changed_part: Minimax certificate, causal debt/service feedback and opportunity/allocation decomposition.
claims.status: component theorem proven; changed-v6 H6/H7 contradicted
claims.v6_current_mechanism: Exact minimax avoidable-deficit allocation on a fixed representative partition; changed-v6 12-world validation fails unchanged H6 and H7.

claims.original_statement: Original contribution1/3 and RQ1: delayed duplicate-safe relay improves evidence freshness at a fixed communication budget.
claims.v4_mechanism_evidence: Historical synthetic and measured-contact DTN studies are retained in standalone scope.
claims.assumptions: Public contacts/identities; next-slot forwarding; immutable observations; charged receipt/feedback bytes.
claims.acceptance_criteria: Delivery deficit <=2pp vs capped epidemic; delay reduction >=15% and group-gap reduction >=20% vs Spray; zero resource violations.
claims.unverified_scope: Closing changed-v6 empirical/common-workload useful-delivery campaign and twin-accuracy benefit.
claims.reuse_status: Retain v4 standalone DTN; changed-v6 shared-resource effects need new evidence.
claims.changed_part: Common arrival clock, DP reservation, lag/TTL separation, causal feedback and byte-exact controls.
claims.status: implementation/diagnostics proven; changed-v6 scientific endpoint incomplete
claims.v6_current_mechanism: Acquisition-time routing with lag-6 usefulness, TTL-24 archival delivery, finite buffers/copies, release reservation, charged controls and a capacity oracle on one trace.

claims.original_statement: Original contribution2/4 and RQ2: user-level private public aggregates with explicit DP-noise treatment in assimilation.
claims.v4_mechanism_evidence: Historical 32,400-row privacy grid/accountant retained for the original independently admitted release path.
claims.assumptions: Whole history may change group; sensitivity 4C/k; no raw state/exact private counts; non-release transcripts excluded.
claims.acceptance_criteria: epsilon<=8; 28 queries; k_min20; deadline24; zero accounting/admission violations; gain vs matched public/availability control.
claims.unverified_scope: Protected citizen value, full-transcript privacy and independent release-only confirmation.
claims.reuse_status: Retain v4 accountant in original scope; v6 contract and adverse value test are separate.
claims.changed_part: Reserved ingress, publication clock, release-only twin and matched availability control.
claims.status: release-only DP contract proven; protected-value gain contradicted for registered family
claims.v6_current_mechanism: Release-only reserved ingress has 28 queries, whole-history epsilon 8, k_min20, delay24 and lag48; suppression is missing and Laplace variance is added once. Matched exposed analysis shows no protected citizen gain.

claims.original_statement: Original contribution1/4: encrypted off-chain traces, Merkle-root commitments, policy metadata and tamper evidence under ledger assumptions.
claims.v4_mechanism_evidence: Historical concurrency/receipt trials, 30 Sepolia anchors and local contract benchmarks are retained where compatible.
claims.assumptions: Accepted receipt defines obligation; registered comparison/read path; one auditor is not general availability; no BFT/finality/censorship/physical-truth inference.
claims.acceptance_criteria: No forged inclusion/terminal acceptance; terminal material reaches affected origins under declared contract; matched detection/cost; visible public-path failures.
claims.unverified_scope: Universal origin return, public availability, gossip, BFT, finality, censorship resistance and scientific throughput.
claims.reuse_status: Retain compatible v4/Sepolia historically; corrected v6 comparison is local engineering evidence.

claims.status: cryptographic/resource engineering proven; universal return contradicted; public availability incomplete
